why_now.industry_shift: Hiring processes increasingly evaluate structured problem-solving, genuine project ownership, and concise communication over rehearsed textbook scripts.
why_now.ai_impact: Automated screening and video screening tools require candidates to understand digital formats, speak with clarity, and use AI ethically for rehearsal rather than real-time deception.
why_now.business_demand: Employers place high value on candidates who listen actively, explain trade-offs clearly, and provide verifiable evidence of their skills and collaboration.
why_now.career_opportunity: Mastering interview communication empowers candidates across tech, design, business, and marketing to represent their true qualifications with confidence.

ai_interview_practice.heading: Practise With AI. Interview With Integrity.
ai_interview_practice.copy: Use modern AI tools to rehearse interview questions, review answer clarity and identify areas for improvement. Learn to evaluate AI feedback critically, communicate your own experiences and respect employer rules during real assessments.
permitted_uses: Employer research planning and question ideation
Interview question generation tailored to specific roles
STAR and CAR answer structure review
ai_limitations: Can misinterpret spoken nuance or context
May misjudge an answer's true technical or domain relevance
Cannot verify personal authenticity or genuine experience
May generate inconsistent or biased scores
Overlooks individual communication styles and accessibility needs
prohibited_uses: Secret real-time live-answer generators during assessments
Presenting AI-authored answers as spontaneous personal experiences
Fabricating skills, metrics, or employment history
Impersonating another candidate or bypassing assessment rules
ai_interview_practice.responsible_prompt: Act as a mock interviewer for the following job role. Ask me one question at a time. After I answer, give feedback on clarity, relevance, structure and supporting evidence. Do not invent achievements or assume skills I have not mentioned. Ask follow-up questions when my answer lacks specific evidence.

digital_safeguards.heading: Professional Practice With Consent, Privacy and Accessibility.
digital_safeguards.platforms: Google Meet OR Zoom (access to one suitable live meeting platform is required)
digital_safeguards.recording_consent: Recording is strictly voluntary. A live assessed interview with documented evaluator notes is a fully valid alternative. Explicit informed consent is mandatory prior to any recording.
digital_safeguards.sensitive_data_protection: No collection of confidential employer documents, identity cards, compensation slips, or private candidate data.
digital_safeguards.accessibility: Accommodates diverse communication needs, hearing/speech differences, and camera preferences without penalty.

portfolio.title: Professional Interview Readiness & Communication Portfolio
portfolio.name: Professional Interview Readiness & Communication Portfolio
portfolio.description: An assessed interview-readiness portfolio containing five verified behavioural stories, one role-specific interview preparation dossier, one 90-second professional introduction, two assessed mock interviews, and individual feedback reports with a final practice plan.

deliverable_01.title: Component 01: Five Verified Behavioural Stories
deliverable_01.description: Five genuine stories drawn from authentic academic, professional, project or volunteer experiences, structured using STAR/CAR frameworks.
coverage: Story B: Challenge, setback or conflict resolution
Story D: Meaningful achievement or project success
Story E: Learning, adaptation or responsible ethical judgment
deliverable_01.authenticity_rule: Stories must reflect actual experiences. No fabricated metrics or invented employment history.

deliverable_02.title: Component 02: Role-Specific Interview Preparation Dossier
deliverable_02.description: A comprehensive, structured interview-preparation dossier based on a real job description or realistic instructor-approved target role.
required_sections: Actual job description or approved realistic role
Project explanation script (Problem → Approach → Contribution → Outcome → Learning)
Five strategic questions to ask the interviewer
deliverable_02.integrity_standard: No invented company facts or hiring policies. All illustrative assumptions clearly labeled.

deliverable_03.title: Component 03: 90-Second Professional Introduction
deliverable_03.description: A clear, concise, role-aligned professional introduction following the Present → Relevant Evidence → Future Direction framework.
deliverable_03.evidence: Written outline plus live assessed delivery OR consent-based recording, accompanied by self-assessment and instructor review notes.
deliverable_03.assessment_criteria: Clarity, accuracy, conciseness, role relevance, natural communication, and appropriate pace.

deliverable_04.title: Component 04: Two Assessed Mock Interviews
deliverable_04.description: Baseline and final interview practice sessions assessed against an objective rubric, conducted live or recorded with informed consent.
evidence_documentation: Evaluator notes on strengths and improvement areas
deliverable_04.recording_policy: Live assessment with documented evaluator notes is fully acceptable. Recording is optional and requires explicit informed consent.

deliverable_05.title: Component 05: Feedback & Improvement Reports
deliverable_05.description: Structured comparison and reflection reports documenting measurable performance growth from baseline to final mock interview, paired with an ongoing practice plan.
required_elements: Revised answer examples addressing evaluator critique
Personal reflection notes on strengths and remaining difficulties
Final actionable practice plan with pre-interview checklist

skill_boundaries.course_81_interview_preparation: Course 81 focuses on interview research, professional introductions, communication fundamentals, behavioural storytelling (STAR/CAR), project explanations, digital and video interviews, two assessed mock interviews, structured feedback, and practice planning.
skill_boundaries.course_79_resume_essentials: Course 79 focuses on ATS-friendly resume structure, job-specific application tailoring, cover letters, and document-level evidence formatting.
skill_boundaries.course_80_linkedin_branding: Course 80 focuses on LinkedIn profile architecture, professional online presence, portfolio showcasing, ethical networking, and job discovery.
skill_boundaries.longer_career_programs: Course 81 serves as a standalone certification or an optional companion to longer technical programs. It is not automatically embedded as a mandatory module across the site.
explicit_exclusions: Detailed DSA preparation or competitive programming
Coding-test mastery or live algorithm examinations
Guaranteed job placement or recruiter selection

lessons.title: Comparing Performance
lessons.what_is_taught: Analyzing baseline versus final performance across communication clarity, evidence quality, structured answering, role relevance, listening, and professional behaviour.

lessons.title: Reflection
lessons.what_is_taught: Reflecting on what improved, what remains difficult, which answers need refinement, how to prepare independently, and future practice priorities.

lessons.title: Final Practice Plan
lessons.what_is_taught: Consolidating key strengths, improvement areas, target role specifications, story refresh schedule, question practice routines, project revision, video/phone readiness, and final pre-interview checklist.

modules.hands_on_lab: Complete TWO assessed mock interviews: Mock 01 Baseline (15–25 mins simulation + feedback) and Mock 02 Final (20–30 mins simulation + feedback). May be conducted live or recorded with consent.
modules.practical_assignment: Submit: Two mock interview assessment records, feedback for Mock 01, feedback for Mock 02, revised answer examples, comparison of performance, final reflection, and final practice plan.
modules.expected_deliverables: Two Assessed Mock Interviews + Individual Feedback & Improvement Reports
modules.career_application: Realistic interview practice, professional communication and independent preparation.
